Hi Kerry and FastPay security team,

Following up on our MAP and the items you flagged during Tuesday's technical review. I pulled a sprintbacklog of outstanding security and compliance asks and attached an itemized spreadsheet for visibility. High level status and asks below, asking for confirmation on owners and dates by EOD Monday 5/17 so we can lock the MAP timeline.

1) SOC 2 - Audit log samples and ingestion proof
   - Ask: provide sample audit logs and a short ingestion plan for your auditors
   - Current owner: FastPay to provide logs, Redwood to map retention policies
   - Target: evidence in docs by 5/24

2) DPA redline discussions
   - Ask: confirm legal redline items and send preferred language for cross-border clauses
   - Owner: FastPay legal + Neha to coordinate responses
   - Target: finalize redline by 5/20 if possible

3) Pen test scope and windows
   - Ask: confirm scope (internal only vs internal+third party) and preferred testing windows
   - Owner: FastPay security to propose dates; Karthik will confirm compatibility with our infra maintenance windows
   - Target: scope signoff by 5/21; testing window TBD but prefer week of 6/7

4) Data retention and access controls - quick clarifications
   - Ask: confirm retention tiers for logs and whether any PI is surfaced in traces
   - Owner: FastPay security + Redwood infra contacts

Attachments: MAP_Security_Itemized_List.xlsx (tabbed list with owners, status, evidence links)

Proposed next checkpoint: 1) quick sync Tue 5/18 10:00 PT, or 2) if that does not work, provide updates in thread by Monday close.

Thanks,
